_comment: Committed snapshot of a representative bench run (the live results/ dir is git-ignored). Regenerate with `node bench/run.mjs --n 500,3000 --classes 800`. Numbers are directional, not a contract — see bench/README.md.
notes: sheets = distinct CSSStyleSheet objects across all shadow roots.
Blink shares parsed CSS *contents* for identical sources (same-URL <link>, byte-identical inline <style>), so per-element cost is objects/nodes/scopes, not N parses.
fouc(ms) = mounted-but-unstyled window; only the fetched 'adopted' variant has one. In a DevTools trace that FOUC surfaced as CLS 0.42 for adopted; the other variants showed CLS 0.00.
uaMem = performance.measureUserAgentSpecificMemory() total bytes (coarse/quantized, whole-agent). jsHeap = post-GC usedJSHeapSize, which does NOT capture renderer-side CSSOM.
An early one-off trace showed a ~4s 'style' mount; it did not reproduce and is not representative.
